evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers rs/q/a/a/a/a directly as exact ScriptPacket ID 32.
Selector 2 rewrites the exact Ancient/custom-magic presentation widgets for Blood vs Infernal barrage/blitz, including magic/on sprites, spell names and level-description text.
Selector 4 places the Client into text-input presentation state using the packet-provided prompt String, clearing the current input buffer and enabling the corresponding input-mode flags.

Selectors 1, 3, 6, 7 and 8 write scalar/flag/runtime presentation state; selector 5 reads three bytes but performs no observable mutation. The complete selector range is 1-8 and no branch dispatches to an unrelated packet family.

The preserved R84 application-protocol authority explicitly classifies subtype 32 as a 'server-controlled presentation/state layer for custom magic' and separately lists 'custom magic presentation toggles' as exact enough to implement client-side while keeping custom-magic combat effects server-owned.
The preserved ApplicationUiService exposes only customMagic* subtype-32 producers: scalar CT/DX, Blood-vs-Infernal mode, prompt, no-op 5, flag 6, five-scalar state and flag 8.

candidates.note: CustomMagicPresentationPacketHandler is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for ScriptPacket 32. Earlier Chat 2 batches deliberately withheld a name because several broad Client fields lacked a common noun; preserved R84 application-protocol authority now independently classifies the entire subtype as a custom-magic presentation/state layer. Confidence is 0.999.
